## Highlights

- Use the native Wails desktop with compact semantic controls, persistent navigation, dismissible feedback, and consistent system, light, and dark presentation.
- Create and edit tasks in a bounded dialog with consistent timing selectors; manage readable Agent Access, Connections, and Settings forms with isolated path-copy feedback.
- See notification status, configured coverage, and recent task outcomes first, with webhook destinations, assignment rules, and diagnostics available through progressive disclosure.
- Manage automation sources, schedules, and activity, and enable optional observe-first local MCP access without changing local offline defaults.
- Connect desktop, CLI, and direct JSON clients to explicitly enabled TLS 1.3 daemons through pinned identities, pairing, capabilities, and audit records.
- Follow one cumulative v1.4.0 boundary after public v1.1.1, staged only after reviewed-source main CI; the maintainer authorized untested native checks under a documented Sandbox-only release waiver, not a claim of full qualification.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.4.0/CHANGELOG.md#140---2026-09-10) for every change.
